map.鱼缸水量计算 使用指南: Fish tank water volume calculation - user guide
map.输入鱼缸长×宽×高（或已有水量），计算实际装水体积与有效水量，并按每厘米鱼长需约: Enter tank length x width x height (or existing water volume) to compute actual and effective water volume, and recommend stocking number and filter/heater setup by about 1 L per cm of fish length. For beginner fish-keeping planning.
map.按缸体形状与底砂厚度算实际水量，据此选择过滤器、加热棒与灯具功率。: Compute the actual water volume from tank shape and substrate thickness, then choose filter, heater, and lighting power accordingly.
map.用常见观赏鱼的每尾所需升数估算合理饲养密度，避免密度过高。: Estimate a reasonable stocking density from the liters required per fish for common ornamental species, avoiding overstocking.
map.按水量确定每次换水量与美制/英制加仑，便于选购进口设备与药剂。: By water amount determine each water change and US/imperial gallons, easy to buy imported equipment and agents.
map.：有效水高 = 缸高 − 底砂厚；长方体 V = 长×宽×水高，圆柱 V = π: : effective water height = tank height - substrate thickness; rectangular V = length x width x water height, cylinder V = pi x (diameter/2)^2 x water height, arched approximated as trapezoid V = (front length + back length)/2 x width x water height (units cm^3). Liter = cm^3 / 1000; actual water = full water x 0.9 (minus decoration and margin). US gallon = liter x 0.264172, imperial = liter x 0.219969. Filter flow = actual water x 4 (L/h), heater = water x 1.5 W, lighting = water x 0.5 W, each water change = water x 0.3 L. Density reference (L/fish): neon tetra 2, guppy 3, tiger barb 8, betta 10, goldfish 20, angelfish 30, koi 50, oscars 80.
map.：60×30×40 cm 长方缸、底砂 5 cm：水高 35 cm，V = 60: : 60 x 30 x 40 cm rectangular tank, 5 cm substrate: water height 35 cm, V = 60 x 30 x 35 = 63,000 cm^3 = 63 L full, actual water = 56.7 L. Suggested filter 227 L/h, heater 85 W, lighting 28 W, water change 17 L each time; at 3 L/fish for guppies about 18 fish.
map.缸内造景石、沉木与水面留边会占用体积，实际可容纳水体少于几何容积；按 0.9 折: Rocks, driftwood, and surface margins occupy volume, so the real water capacity is less than the geometric volume; scaling by 0.9 better matches the true water change and medication dose.
map.过滤流量为什么是水量的 4 倍？: Why is the filtration flow four times the water volume?
map.每小时循环 3–5 次可维持有效生化过滤与水体流动，4 倍是常用中值；高密度或大: Circulating 3-5 times per hour maintains effective biological filtration and water flow; four times is a common midpoint; higher density or large fish need a larger value.
